method: Read the preserved original checkout's local data/tiles_v4/park_city/index.csv, image tiles, and class maps. Compared tile pixel centers against the source NAIP raster footprint and counted outside-footprint optical and class-map pixels. No original checkout files were modified.

source.tile_data_identity: Not established. The prior provisional crop check matched 0/45 canonical A image hashes and 0/45 class-map hashes; treat these raster and label counts as local V4 diagnostics until reproduced on the canonical Kaggle tiles.

interpretation: In the local V4 export, padded optical pixels beyond the NAIP footprint are represented as zero imagery and ordinary class-0 background; TrailTileDataset assigns class 0 the default background weight 1.0. No local V4 positive labels were found outside the image footprint. Because tile raster identities are not canonical A, reproduce this count against the exact Kaggle-prepared A tiles before using it as a baseline correction result.

candidate_fix.behavior: When true, tile generation marks only pixels outside the source raster's pixel grid as class 4 (ignored); the target becomes zero and the dataset weight becomes zero. It does not inspect pixel values and preserves all in-footprint labels and imagery.
candidate_fix.reason: Leave the setting off by default to preserve A's existing tile outputs, IDs, and replay comparability. Enable only in a new, explicitly versioned data build after canonical identity and evaluation-mask handling are checked.
